description: This file defines a Config class and related attributes for managing application configuration in a Flask-based project, including methods for loading configuration from files, environment variables, and objects.

classes.name: ConfigAttribute
classes.description: A generic class that forwards attribute access to the application's config dictionary, with optional value conversion.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A dictionary subclass that provides methods to load configuration data from files, environment variables, objects, and mappings, tailored for Flask applications.

methods.name: from_envvar
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file specified by an environment variable.

methods.name: from_prefixed_env
methods.description: Loads environment variables with a specific prefix into the config, supporting nested dictionaries.

methods.name: from_pyfile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a Python file.

methods.name: from_object
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified object or module.

methods.name: from_file
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file using a specified loader function.

methods.name: from_mapping
methods.description: Updates the config with a mapping, ignoring non-uppercase keys.

methods.name: get_namespace
methods.description: Returns a subset of configuration options matching a namespace/prefix.
